title: the gospel in three verses

verses.text: for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God,
For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
that if you confess with your mouth, “Jesus is Lord,” and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved.

caption:
The whole gospel fits inside three verses of one letter.

Paul lays it out plainly. Every one of us falls short, the gift was given anyway, and the door opens with an honest confession and a believing heart. None of it rests on you being impressive first.

Romans 3:23, 6:23 and 10:9 (BSB)

Save this for the day grace feels far off. Send it to someone who is still deciding.
